title: The Brazier and His Dog
summary: A brass-worker hammered pots and kettles all day. His little dog slept peacefully through the deafening din of hammers and clanging bronze....
full_text:
A brass-worker hammered pots and kettles all day. His little dog slept peacefully through the deafening din of hammers and clanging bronze.

Yet the moment the brass-worker laid down his tools and began slicing meat, the dog awoke instantly, whining for a morsel.

The master rebuked the beast: "Lazy cur! The roar of the forge cannot wake you, but the quiet movement of my jaws brings you leaping to your feet!"
moral: Those who sleep through the hour of work have no claim upon the table.
